content.text: I've finished scrolling all 10 screens and I'm writing up what I'd tell a friend now.

input.answer: I'd open an account at Psagot (פסגות) and buy the Yalin Lapidot S&P 500 index fund (ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D), number 5139282), because the page marks that pair "הזול" (the cheapest). On the page's example of 10,000 ₪ now plus 500 ₪ a month for 10 years, I'd end up with about 86,500 ₪ (86,492 ₪) after paying in 70,000 ₪. I didn't change the numbers to my own 30,000 ₪, so my total would be different.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the input fields (סכום היום 10,000 / הפקדה חודשית 500)
stuck.why: I have 30,000, not 10,000. It's a screenshot so I couldn't change it, and I kept the page's example. So the 86,492 isn't really my number.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the next-best box: '86,449 ₪' with '−43 ₪ לעומת הבחירה שלכם' under it
stuck.why: For a second the minus 43 looked like a loss. Then I got it: it ends up 43 ₪ less than my choice.

stuck.where: Screen 2 onward, the fund list on the left
stuck.why: There are about 20 funds with coloured tags that all look alike. I stopped reading them and went with the one the page had already picked.
At the top the page said my choice was Psagot. Here it says 'now' is Jerusalem (ירושלים) with a different fund. I got confused about what 'now' means and which one I actually picked.

stuck.where: Screen 5, the currency-hedged fund (מנוטרלת מט"ח) showing 'בין +2,212 ₪ ל־ −23,766 ₪'
stuck.why: A wide range with a big minus. It scared me off that fund straight away.

Account card 'פסגות ניירות ערך', 'מה החשבון גובה ב־10 שנים: 1,057 ₪'
Fund card 'ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D) 5139282', 'דמי ניהול 0%'
The account ranking on the right: פסגות first, then לאומי at 83,396
The bar chart's top label, 'הכי הרבה בכל המחירונים 86,492 ₪ ילין לפידות... פסגות'
skimmed: The long list of funds with coloured tags (screens 2–5)
The 'לא בחשבון' notes under each bank
The sensitivity chart and its table, 'מה הכי משנה את מה שיישאר לכם' (screen 6)

The text 'למה חלק מהקרנות בלי מחיר בפסגות'
The whole section 'עם נטרול מט"ח או בלי' and its yearly bar charts (screen 7)
The footnotes at the bottom and 'חוקים וכללים'
unsure_meaning: מוטב / סם גם על שינוי המטבע
The dotted underline under the numbers: is it a link?
The colours in the stacked bars (orange, yellow, red). I guessed red meant fees.
not_found: A clear first step, like an 'open an account' button or a link to Psagot
The result for my own 30,000 ₪ (I couldn't move the slider)
Why Psagot is cheapest, explained in plain words

findings.what: The example starts at 10,000 ₪ and you have to change it yourself. The big 86,492 sticks in your head even though it isn't your amount.
The 'עכשיו' (now) section shows Jerusalem with a different fund. It contradicts the Psagot choice from the top and confused me.
About 20 funds in a row with lots of coloured tags I don't understand. Way too much choice.
Jargon all over: נאמן, צוברת, עסקת החלף, מנוטרל מט"ח, 4D/4A, and no plain explanation
The minus sign in '−43 ₪' looks like a loss at first
Nothing tells you what to actually do next (open an account, how to buy the fund)
The colours in the bars aren't explained right next to them, so I had to guess
findings.where: Screens 2–4, the bars in the account list
